### Pitchers

The pitchers included in this data set are 10 standout pitchers in the last decade: Clayton Kershaw, Justin Verlander, Max Scherzer, Chris Sale, Madison Bumgarner, Cole Hamels, Zack Greinke, David Price, Jacob deGrom, and Jon Lester.

## Data

Each row in the `pitchers` data set represents a pitch thrown by one of the pitchers  in their 2015-2019 seasons. 

<details>

<summary><b>Variable Descriptions</b></summary>

| Variable    | Description                                               |
|-------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|
| year        | Year raced                                                |
| boatType    | Type of boat raced (canoe, kayak, SUP)                    |
| bib         | Bib number                                                |
| classID     | Class (oc4stock, oc2pro, etc)                             |
| place       | Where the boat placed in their class's results            |
| time        | The time to complete the race (in sec)                    |

</details>

**Download Pitching Data:** [pitchers.csv](pitchers.csv){target="_blank"}
